en: The front side of the postcard shows a hand-colored image of a grand, multi-story building known as 'Haus Windmüller' with classic European architecture, surrounded by neatly arranged trees along the street. The bottom of the image includes text in German. The reverse side contains the word 'Postkarte,' some handwritten and stamped markings, and a blue museum stamp from 'MUSEUM IM SCHLOSS BAD PYRMONT.'
